description: This file declares the NativeJSImplementation class which implements the INativeJS interface for managing native JavaScript applications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations for initializing, deinitializing, creating, running, and terminating applications, as well as running JavaScript code. The class maintains internal state with a render thread, a running flag, and a shared pointer to a renderer object.
